buyerName.description: Buyer name (BT-44); the customer's full name (EN 16931 BR-07 / VAT Directive art. 226(5)).

cardPan.description: Card primary account number (BT-87); an Invoice should never include a full card PAN (EN 16931 BR-51). Must remain absent.

itemStandardId.description: Item standard identifier (BT-157) at line level; requires a scheme identifier (EN 16931 BR-64).

itemClassificationId.description: Item classification identifier (BT-158) at line level; requires a scheme identifier (EN 16931 BR-65).
